title: Consolidate button token set and rework loading/disabled/icon affordances
creator: Maya Chen
description: Refactor the primary button surface tokens and the icon/button spacing rules so we have a single, opinionated set of semantic tokens for button variants. Address two regressions seen in recent releases: 1) loading spinner misalignment when iconOnly buttons use compact tokens, 2) disabled state low-contrast on high-contrast themes. Deliverables: updated token spec, Figma component variants, accessibility checks, and a concise engineering handoff with migration notes for existing components.
acceptance_criteria: A single canonical token map (semantic names) exists for button backgrounds, borders, text, and focus rings used by all variants
Figma library contains updated components: Primary/Secondary/Ghost/Icon/IconOnly with explicit loading and disabled variants
Loading state uses a shared spinner component sized/offset consistently across icon and text buttons
Disabled tokens meet WCAG AAA 4.5:1 contrast for high-contrast theme and AA 3:1 for normal theme where applicable
Engineering implementation notes include migration path and deprecation schedule for legacy tokens
Regression bugs referenced (ENG-BUG-3424, ENG-BUG-3491) are verified as fixed in the staging release
comments: 2025-02-12 Maya Chen: Ticket created after design triage. Scope narrowed to token consolidation + loading/disabled regressions. Recommended semantic token names: button-bg-primary, button-text-primary, button-bg-ghost, button-border-secondary, button-focus-ring. Will propose color deltas for hover/focus instead of separate absolute colors to reduce token explosion.

2025-02-13 Liam O'Connor: Started exploration in Figma. Early note: iconOnly buttons currently reuse compact padding tokens which cause spinner to clip. Proposed introducing spinnerMargin token and explicit spinner-size per density.
2025-02-15 PM - Anika Rao: Prioritize this ahead of theming rollout—customers reported inconsistent disabled states in dark theme. PM asks for migration notes and a compatibility flag for older SDKs.

2025-02-18 Engineering review (ENG-1957): Feedback from runtime team: ensure tokens map cleanly to runtime props (variant, tone, density). Also request an optional CSS variable fallback for Private deployments that can't upgrade immediately.

2025-02-20 Maya Chen: Updated Figma with semantic tokens and created a component variant matrix (default/hover/active/focus/loading/disabled) for four densities. Added notes on when to use ghost vs secondary to prevent accidental CTA dilution.

2025-02-22 Accessibility review (Leila Martinez): Disabled contrast for high-contrast theme adjusted. Recommend adding aria-busy semantics on loading buttons and ensuring focus isn't trapped when spinner appears.

2025-02-24 Liam O'Connor: Implemented prototype tokens in code sandbox; spinner alignment fixed by adding spinnerMargin and swapping from absolute offsets to flex alignment. Found regression: right-side icons in split buttons overlap when density=compact—added a follow-up bug ticket ENG-3602.
2025-02-26 Maya Chen: Preparing handoff doc and migration guide. Will mark legacy tokens deprecated but not removed until two releases after console-2025.03. Ready for design review tomorrow.
